Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649941 where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
